title: CLI reference
lead: svelte-dialect ships one executable with three commands: typegen, check and migrate. There is no config file, so every setting is a flag.
usage_text: Run it with no arguments, or with --help as the only argument, to print the command list and exit with 0. An unknown command prints the same list and exits with 1. A flag the command doesn't know, a messages directory it can't read and invalid JSON are errors too: the command prints one line to stderr and exits with 1.
typegen_lead: Writes a .d.ts file with the MessageKey union and the MessageParams shapes. {#typed}Typed keys{/typed} shows how to use them.
typegen_flag_messages: The messages directory, laid out as <locale>/<namespace>.json. Repeat the flag to merge several directories, for example a bundled tree and a lazy one. Ignored when --from-json is given.
typegen_flag_from_json: Read a \{locale: \{namespace: \{…\}\}\} JSON dump instead of a directory. Meant for catalogs that live in a database.
typegen_flag_out: The file to write. Its directory has to exist already. An existing file is overwritten.
typegen_exit_1: Unknown flag, a --messages directory or a --from-json file that can't be read, invalid JSON, or an --out path that can't be written.
check_lead: Compares the t('ns:key') calls found in your source with the message files, so a renamed or deleted key fails in CI instead of showing up as raw text in production.
check_note: The scan searches the source as plain text and does not parse it, so it sees string literals only: a key built from a variable or from a template literal with $\{…\} is skipped, both for the missing list and for --unused. A loadTranslations('ns') call is checked as ns:*, which fails when a locale has no such namespace.
check_flag_messages: The messages directory, laid out as <locale>/<namespace>.json. Repeatable.
check_flag_src: The directory to scan, recursively, for .ts, .js and .svelte files. node_modules and directories starting with a dot are skipped.
check_flag_unused: Also list the keys in the message files that no code references. It doesn't change the exit code.
check_exit_0: Every key the code uses exists in every locale.
check_exit_1: A used key is missing from at least one locale, no locale was found under --messages while keys were in use, or the command failed as described under Usage.
migrate_lead: Converts i18next and ICU MessageFormat JSON files to MF2, in place. The {#guide}migration guide{/guide} follows one migration from start to finish.
migrate_note: Results and the summary go to stdout, warnings to stderr. A file is rewritten only when at least one of its messages changed, as JSON indented with tabs. A second run changes nothing.
migrate_flag_messages: The messages directory to convert, laid out as <locale>/<namespace>.json. Repeatable: each directory is migrated on its own.
migrate_flag_dry_run: Print every change as a before and after pair and write nothing.
migrate_flag_strict: Exit with 1 when any warning was emitted. The files are still written; the flag only changes the exit code, for CI.
migrate_exit_0: The run finished. Warnings alone don't fail it.
migrate_exit_strict: --strict was given and at least one warning was emitted.
migrate_exit_flat: The directory holds only flat <locale>.json files, so nothing could be migrated. Move each into <locale>/<namespace>.json.
migrate_exit_1: Unknown flag, a messages directory that can't be read, or invalid JSON.
